fixed: Opening a very long dance link no longer holds up the app for a moment while it is checked: the link is read in the background.
A dance link with a version no app writes, such as 0 or letters, is now reported as damaged, instead of as made by a newer version with advice to update.
Reading a text or Markdown file with one dance and many paragraphs of notes under it no longer takes seconds: it now takes about as long as any other file of that size.

A web address that names this device or the local network in another form, such as 2130706433, 0x7f.0.0.1, 0177.0.0.1 or 127.1, is now refused for an import or a calendar address, as 127.0.0.1 already was.

A file staged for the share sheet, such as a spreadsheet, a calendar file or a backup, is now deleted the next time you share a file or start the app, instead of staying in the app's temporary folder. On iPhone, iPad and Android, the copy the file picker makes of a file you import or restore is deleted once it has been read.
